up: I need all activity records from the assay identified by ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4808149'. For each activity record, show the compound's ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), the canonical SMILES (from compound_structures), and the activity details including standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units. Do not impose any additional filters. Return every matching row without any row limit.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4808149';
